title: Tulshibaug Ganpati
text:
Tulshibaug Ganpati (तुळशीबाग गणपती) — 4 (Chautha Manacha), located in Tulshibaug, Budhwar Peth, Pune, established 1901.

History: Tulshibaug Ganpati, established in 1901, is the fourth Manacha and sits in the heart of the historic Tulshibaug market. In 1975 it became the first mandal in Pune to use a fibreglass idol; the current idol is 13 feet tall, adorned with over 80 kg of silver ornaments. Evening aartis draw enormous crowds, and the narrow Tulshibaug lanes packed with devotees are one of the most memorable sights of Pune's Ganeshotsav.

Idol/Deity: 13-feet tall fibreglass idol (first of its kind in Pune, 1975), adorned with 80+ kg of silver ornaments.
